headlines.title: Watch: Stevens endorses Rogers in last-minute shakeup
headlines.description: Rep. Haley Stevens, D-Mich., endorsed Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers, a major shake-up in the final stages of a top battleground race that could determine which party controls the Senate.

headlines.title: Kornacki: Why Trump is ‘in worse shape’ heading into his 2nd midterms
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki joins Meet the Press to break down the final NBC News poll before the midterms and which party has the momentum heading into Election Day.

headlines.title: Democrats in key battlegrounds throw Joe Biden under the bus on the border
headlines.description: Democratic candidates in 2026 battleground races are criticizing Joe Biden’s handling of border security, seeking to neutralize a political vulnerability.

headlines.title: Sen. Tim Scott dodges on whether he would accept the results of the Alaska Senate race
headlines.description: Sen. Tim Scott, R-S.C., declined to say whether he would accept the results of the Alaska Senate race if Democrat Mary Peltola wins the battleground seat

headlines.title: Alaska officials ask judge to deny DOJ’s ‘impossible’ demand to set aside ballots
headlines.description: The Republican-led state government in Alaska implored a federal judge on Saturday to permanently dismiss the Trump administration’s lawsuit seeking to block the certification of Alaska’s Senate race if GOP Sen.

headlines.title: Go Behind the Scenes of NBC News’ Decision Desk
headlines.description: TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie goes behind-the-scenes with the NBC News team tasked with calling election night’s pivotal races from coast-to-coast.

headlines.title: Sen. Chris Murphy hospitalized after stroke
headlines.description: Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., was hospitalized Saturday after a stroke, a spokesperson for the senator said Sunday.

headlines.title: Golden State Valkyries defeat Atlanta Dream for franchise’s first WNBA title
headlines.description: In only their second season in existence, the Golden State Valkyries are WNBA champions.

headlines.title: South Korea is fighting its baby bust and could be a model for battling population decline
headlines.description: South Korea, dealing with one of the lowest fertility rates in the world, is trying to change course by offering loads of incentives for young adults to have kids. The real solution might not be only economic, but cultural too. NBC News' Janis Mackey Frayer reports from Seoul.

headlines.title: Stores looted in German riots as Gen Z activists protest living costs, military service
headlines.description: Rioters looted stores and set fires to barricades in Frankfurt on Saturday as protests across Germany demanded lower living costs and better education.

headlines.title: ‘Looks like Mars’: Toxic smog from Indonesia wildfires sparks health crisis, protests
headlines.description: Wildfires in Indonesia are blanketing the country and other southeast Asian nations in toxic smog, prompting widespread protests.

headlines.title: Outcry prompts ‘Call of Duty’ to cut Seoul tragedy footage
headlines.description: American video game publisher Activision said Friday that it was removing controversial footage from its newly released “Call of Duty” game after an outcry in South Korea over the inclusion of real-life footage from a deadly 2022 Halloween crowd crush in Seoul.
